title: Be authorised by APRA to carry on banking business
what: Only the Reserve Bank and bodies corporate authorised by APRA as authorised deposit-taking institutions (ADIs) may carry on banking business in Australia.

sources.title: Banking Act 1959
sources.quote: (1) A body corporate commits an offence if: (a) the body corporate carries on any banking business in Australia; and (b) the body corporate is not the Reserve Bank; and (c) the body corporate is not an ADI;

sources.title: Banking Act 1959
sources.quote: (2A) APRA may, by legislative instrument, set criteria for the granting of an authority to carry on banking business in Australia.
